attacker_pocs.name: deep_zstd_channels
attacker_pocs.why: A valid 33-channel ZSTD deep scanline image reaches the new layout-size check through DeepScanLineInputFile::readPixels; its per-channel stack bookkeeping is exceeded.

role_a_rationale: The decoder now checks the reconstructed ZSTD layout against the declared unpacked chunk size before inverse sorting, preventing the described undersized-buffer copy. The check follows the existing channel-grid flow and passes ordinary deep and flat ZSTD reads. A fixed per-channel accumulator in the new check has only 32 entries; a valid image with 33 channels causes a new ASan-detected stack out-of-bounds access. The same input exits normally on the pinned parent.
